about: The life pass (gen/life/progress.md): what the whole scroll's talk shares. kinds: who you play (world.js settings key avatar) -> the kind the painted people answer (guan official, shi scholar, seng monk, fu woman, tong child, jun soldier, li labourer, min anyone else); a beat's `as` gives a line per kind. threads: the plot lines that run across the scroll; each step is told by a scene, chatter exchange or bark in its section that carries the step's id in `step`; overhearing it inks the step into the 圖志 (prefs.discovered 'h:<step>'). note = the journal's line for the step (繁體, no numerals); hint = for the writers only (never shown). Bundled by tools/ui_data.mjs (tools/talk_data.mjs).

threads.title: 城門爭稅
threads.lead: 城門口的一場爭執，一路傳到城外。
threads.lead_en: A row at the city gate, talked of all the way out of town.
threads.src: 余辉 2023/2015 (the quarrel at the tax office, the watchman looking down); 名画记 35 (the 引子 permit). That others along the road talk about it is our proposal.

steps.note: 城門稅務所裏，稅吏說匹帛稅重，車夫驚得張大了嘴。
steps.note_en: At the gate's tax office the clerk names a heavy silk tax; a carter gapes.
steps.hint: the tax quarrel itself (S5.grp.tax_quarrel): scene V5.1 or its chatter

steps.note: 城門外閒坐的人說，稅務所裏又吵起來了。
steps.note_en: Idlers outside the gate say the tax office is quarrelling again.
steps.src: 邵琦 (men resting by the wall); our proposal
steps.hint: the idlers at the gate block's foot (S5.grp.wall_idlers) talk of the row inside

steps.note: 賣卦攤上，一個客商問：城門稅重，買賣還做得成麼？
steps.note_en: At the fortune-teller's a trader asks: with the gate tax so heavy, will my deal work?
steps.hint: the fortune-teller's client (S4.grp.fortune_teller_stall)

steps.note: 棕蓋車停在路邊，車夫說城門口查得緊。
steps.note_en: A palm-covered cart waits by the road; its carter says the gate checks are strict.
steps.src: 名画记 27 (the palm-covered carts); our proposal
steps.hint: the first palm-covered cart, waiting (S4b.grp.palm_cart_13070), or its carters

threads.title: 漕糧入城
threads.lead: 船上卸下的糧袋，一路運到城裏的正店。
threads.lead_en: Grain sacks from the boats, carried all the way to the town's wine house.
threads.src: 名画记 9 (仓前成市: grain unloaded at the wharf), 名画记 37 and 余辉 2023 (the sack cart at 孫羊正店; grain for the brewing); the road between is our proposal.

steps.note: 碼頭上卸糧，船主坐在麻袋上，記賬的一袋袋點數。
steps.note_en: Grain is unloaded at the wharf; the owner sits on his sacks while the tally man counts.
steps.hint: grain unloading on the bank (S2.grp.grain_unloading): the owner on his sacks, the tally men

steps.note: 扛袋的腳夫說，這些糧要運進城裏去。
steps.note_en: The sack porters say this grain is going into town.
steps.hint: porters carrying sacks along the bank (S2.grp.sack_porters_24312)

steps.note: 虹橋下，馱著大糧袋的驢往城裏走。
steps.note_en: Below the Rainbow Bridge, donkeys with big grain sacks head for town.
steps.hint: the two donkeys with big sacks (S3.grp.sack_donkeys_18600) and whoever drives them

steps.note: 城門裏，運糧的也要納稅，說是送去正店釀酒。
steps.note_en: Inside the gate the grain carriers pay tax too: the grain is for the wine house's brewing.
steps.src: 余辉 2023 (more taxpayers; grain for the brewing 正店)
steps.hint: the pack train and cart by the depot (S5.grp.pack_train)

steps.note: 孫羊正店門前，驢車卸下糧袋，正店要釀酒。
steps.note_en: At the Sun Yang wine house door a donkey cart unloads grain for brewing.
steps.hint: the sack cart, its team and carters (S6.grp.sack_cart_5410)

threads.title: 節下的酒
threads.lead: 從腳店的新酒旗，到軍巡鋪的酒桶，再到藥鋪的招牌。
threads.lead_en: From the tavern's new-wine banner to the fire post's casks to the doctor's sign.
threads.src: 名画记 23 (新酒), 余辉 2023 (the fire post's casks, the wagons racing to fetch them), 名画记 36 (孫羊正店), 名画记 48 (趙太丞家: 治酒所伤真方集香丸, drinking was the fashion).

steps.note: 十千腳店掛著新酒旗，酒客進進出出。
steps.note_en: The Shiqian tavern flies its new-wine banner; drinkers come and go.
steps.hint: 十千脚店 (S3.grp.shiqian_jiaodian_16800): a guest, the doorman, or the groom resting

steps.note: 城門內的軍巡鋪裏，弓手守著酒桶，等車來拉。
steps.note_en: In the fire post inside the gate, archers guard the wine casks, waiting for the cart.
steps.hint: archers in the wine depot (S5.grp.wine_depot_archers): where's the cart?

steps.note: 十字街口，軍車急急轉彎，說是去拉節下的酒。
steps.note_en: At the crossroads army wagons swing round in a hurry, off to fetch the holiday wine.
steps.hint: the big wagon turning the corner (S6.grp.taiping_wagon_3600)

steps.note: 孫羊正店樓上，酒客舉杯，說這香醪果然好。
steps.note_en: Upstairs at the Sun Yang wine house, drinkers raise cups to the fine brew.
steps.src: 名画记 36; the lamp-box 香醪
steps.hint: drinkers upstairs at the 正店 (S6.grp.upper_table_5500)

steps.note: 趙太丞家的招牌寫著治酒所傷，可見喝酒成風。
steps.note_en: Doctor Zhao's sign offers a cure for drink: drinking was the fashion.
steps.hint: at 赵太丞家 (S7.grp.zhao_taicheng_patients or the house): someone reads the sign

threads.title: 炭驢進城
threads.lead: 畫卷開頭的炭驢，馱的是城裏酒店灶下的炭。
threads.lead_en: The charcoal donkeys at the scroll's start carry fuel for the town's tavern stoves.
threads.src: 名画记 1 (赶驴入城: two drovers drive donkeys loaded with charcoal), 名画记 21 (the charcoal the donkey train brings feeds the riverside tavern's stoves); the map's charcoal(?) panniers at the S4 stall.

steps.note: 兩個腳夫趕著毛驢，馱著木炭往城裏去。
steps.note_en: Two drovers drive donkeys loaded with charcoal toward town.
steps.hint: the charcoal donkey train (S1.grp.charcoal_train)

steps.note: 虹橋邊的小酒館，灶下燒的正是城外運來的炭。
steps.note_en: The little tavern by the bridge burns charcoal brought from the country.
steps.hint: the small tavern by the bridge (MHJ 21): its kitchen-door stall or its staff

steps.note: 寺前路口，又有馱炭的驢在歇腳。
steps.note_en: At the road by the temple, more charcoal donkeys rest.
steps.hint: the pack donkeys' drover (S4.grp.pack_donkeys_10487)

threads.title: 郊外驚馬
threads.lead: 郊外一匹馬驚了，消息傳到了河邊。
threads.lead_en: A horse bolted in the fields, and the news reached the river.
threads.src: 余辉 (惊马闯市: a bolting horse, its chasers, an old man calling a child out of the way); 名画记 10 (the travellers resting at the shed); the news spreading is our proposal.

steps.note: 郊外一匹馬驚了，幾個人跟在後面追。
steps.note_en: Out in the fields a horse has bolted; men run after it.
steps.hint: the runaway horse and its chasers (S1.grp.runaway_horse)

steps.note: 路邊有人急喚孩子，躲開那匹驚馬。
steps.note_en: By the road someone calls a child out of the bolting horse's way.
steps.src: 余辉; the map (the man at the post stretches his arm toward a child)
steps.hint: the man leaning on the post and the child (S1.grp.runaway_horse)

steps.note: 河邊歇腳的客人說，郊外有馬驚了。
steps.note_en: Travellers resting by the river say a horse bolted out in the fields.
steps.hint: the travellers resting at the shed's east end (S2.grp.donkey_at_shed_east_end_28940) or the diners

threads.title: 大船過橋
threads.title_en: The Big Boat at the Bridge
threads.lead: 一艘大船險些撞上虹橋，滿橋的人都在喊。
threads.lead_en: A big boat nearly hits the Rainbow Bridge; the whole bridge shouts.
threads.src: 名画记 19, 20 (大船穿行虹桥, 拥挤的桥面); that the boatmen beyond talk of it is our proposal.

steps.note: 大船要過虹橋，船工忙著放倒桅桿。
steps.note_en: A big boat must pass the Rainbow Bridge; the crew lower the mast.
steps.hint: the big boat and its crew (S3.grp.boat_mast_lowering_crew)

steps.note: 橋上的人朝下喊，有人拋下繩去。
steps.note_en: People on the bridge shout down; someone throws a rope.
steps.hint: the crowd at the near railing calling down (S3.grp.shouting_down_to_boat)

steps.note: 泊在岸邊的船家說，方才虹橋底下好險。
steps.note_en: A moored boatman says it was a close call under the Rainbow Bridge.
steps.src: 名画记 25 (boats moored at the bend); our proposal
steps.hint: a moored boat's boatman (S4b.grp.long_cabin_boat_crew or arched_awning_boat_crew)

threads.title: 清明上墳
threads.lead: 清明時節，城裏城外都是上墳的人。
threads.lead_en: At Qingming, town and country are full of people visiting graves.
threads.src: 名画记 6 (杨柳杂花装簇轿顶: 清明节扫墓回城), 名画记 13 (王家纸马铺), 名画记 27 (the palm cart family, perhaps back from the graves), 余辉 2014 (列售纸码 in the inner city).

steps.note: 轎頂插著楊柳雜花，一家人上墳回城。
steps.note_en: Willow and flowers on the sedan roof: a family back from the graves.
steps.hint: the tomb-sweeping party coming home (S1.grp.tomb_sweeping_party)

steps.note: 王家紙馬鋪前，有人來買上墳的紙錢。
steps.note_en: At the Wang paper-goods shop, people buy paper money for the graves.
steps.hint: the hooded rider at the paper shop (S2.grp.rider_26832) or the shop

steps.note: 棕蓋車裏的婦人掀簾往外看，許是上墳回來。
steps.note_en: A woman lifts the curtain of a palm-covered cart, back from the graves perhaps.
steps.hint: the palm-covered cart (S4b.grp.palm_cart_13070 / _13455): the woman at the back door, the servants

steps.note: 城裏也賣紙馬，清明了，上墳用的都有。
steps.note_en: Paper horses are sold in town too: everything for the graves at Qingming.
steps.src: 余辉 2014 (列售纸码); 余辉 2023
steps.hint: the paper-horse stall (S6.grp.paper_stall)

threads.title: 書屏遭廢
threads.lead: 一扇草書屏風被當作苫布，推出城去。
threads.lead_en: A cursive-script screen, used as a tarp, carted out of town.
threads.src: 余辉 2015 (书屏遭废: a banned 元祐 faction's cursive screen used as a tarp, carted out to be destroyed; its twin at 十千脚店). 名画记 24 reads the 串车's load as strings of coins: disputed, we stage 余辉's reading.

steps.note: 出城的車上蓋著一扇草書屏風，推車的直說可惜。
steps.note_en: A cart leaving town is covered with a calligraphy screen; its pusher calls it a pity.
steps.hint: the screen cart crew (S5.grp.screen_cart_8510)

steps.note: 腳店門前的串車上，也蓋著一扇字屏。
steps.note_en: The cart at the tavern door carries a calligraphy screen too.
steps.src: 余辉 2015 (its twin at 十千脚店); 名画记 24 (the 串车)
steps.hint: the 串车 and the men at it (S3.grp.chuanche_17775)

steps.note: 士子們低聲說，元祐諸公的字如今藏不得了。
steps.note_en: Scholars whisper that the Yuanyou men's calligraphy can no longer be kept.
steps.src: 余辉 2015 (the 崇宁 bans on 元祐 writings); our proposal
steps.hint: the exam scholars (S6.grp.exam_scholars_3240), quietly
